features.quote: Cap turn budgets at ~2× the survival-curve cliff. Most spiral signal is in the first N turns; long tails are expensive and add little.
features.justification_quote: long tails are expensive and add little

features.quote: Don't ship the broken-harness tasks as a public/contaminating benchmark — if these leak into training data, future Qwen checkpoints learn the test and your regression signal dies.
features.justification_quote: future Qwen checkpoints learn the test and your regression signal dies

features.quote: An eval that scores 'failed to complete' as degradation will reward you for building agents that flail confidently and punish agents that correctly give up. That is the opposite of reliability.
features.justification_quote: you'll regression-test your models toward a worse failure mode while your dashboard turns green
